highlights_headline: The unreleased 4.159 line adds experimental image comparison APIs in a separate SkiaSharp.Testing package.

breaking.title: Move away from Linux x86 native assets
breaking.body: Linux x86 native builds and NuGet package entries have been removed. Move 32-bit x86 Linux deployments to a supported architecture before upgrading.

bullets.detail: SkiaSharp.Testing adds SKImageComparison for SKImage, SKBitmap and SKPixmap, with channel tolerances, masks, mismatch budgets, error metrics and difference images. To use the experimental assembly, suppress diagnostic SKIA4001 with NoWarn or a pragma. Comparison results retain no native handles; callers own returned difference images.
